attributes.name: Eliandra
attributes.powers:
Bury this card to redeem a card that has the Corrupted trait.

During any character's move step, you may give this card to any character.

Display this card to explore your location. When you reset your hand at the end of the turn, choose any number; treat your hand size as that number until the end of the turn, then bury this card.

corrections.issue: When you use Eliandra to choose your hand size, how long does that last?
